decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system complements our established coolant management portfolio and we retain it to realize its market potential.
As a natural extension of our coolant cleaning range, we keep the centrifuge to meet ongoing customer demand.
The coolant nozzle product line with multiple models still requires time to assess, but it strengthens our nozzle offering.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to our core conveyor portfolio and we keep it to serve customer needs.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a logical extension of our chip conveyor range and we keep it to maintain a full product lineup.
